name: What types of exterior trim materials are available for replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of exterior trim materials are available for replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exterior trim replacement offers various material options, each with distinct advantages. Common choices include wood (like redwood or cedar), engineered wood products, PVC/cellular vinyl, and fiber cement. Wood provides a classic aesthetic but requires more maintenance, while PVC and fiber cement offer greater durability and resistance to rot and insects with less upkeep. The best material often depends on your home's style, local climate, and maintenance preferences, as well as your budget. We can help you assess which material best suits your home in areas like Alameda or Berkeley, considering factors like moisture exposure and desired lifespan.
